name: Mastery Seeker
description: Good enough is never good enough, they need to be the best
behavioral_signature: Pursues absolute excellence in their chosen domain above all else
under_stress: Neglects everything outside their craft, including survival
at_rest: Practicing, refining, studying the masters who came before
will_never: settle for competence when mastery is possible
unless: someone needs them to be present more than they need to be perfect
